standup-mobi 1.0.1

- Improved guidance in the extraction interview: clarified not to write passwords/keys into notes or runbooks; specify vault or system names only.
- Updated SKILL.md with best practices for secrets management in documentation and runbooks.
- Added new "Common Pitfalls" specifically warning against including secrets in shared documentation.
- Removed skill-card.md.

Initial release of Standup Mobi — tactical absence coverage tool for teams.

- Automates the process of listing and assigning absent team member duties with fairness and capacity constraints.
- Detects and flags undocumented, "tribal" knowledge for rapid extraction.
- Provides a 1-week ramp-up plan for substitutes with progressive shadow→assist→solo structure.
- Generates a printable daily/weekly checklist for temporary coverage, no software required.
- Works whether or not the absent teammate is available for knowledge transfer.
- Includes a 12-question interview template to extract critical process knowledge when possible.
